**WorldPainter maps keep every layer of every block**

A WorldPainter world comes in with every layer of every block, each with its own intensity: a block painted with a forest at 50 %, bushes at 15 % and 8 % and three ground covers keeps all of them, rather than the one Massif kept before. Covers lie over each other as WorldPainter lays them (Conquest Reforged's grass layers on the ground, plants on them, frost on top) and the export places each one, and the Info panel lists them all. Ground covers of layer blocks (Conquest Reforged's `*_layer` blocks, snow layers, mixes of several) are now found even when Conquest Reforged is not read in the Blocks panel, and are offered first in the import report to become the ground's own; Edit ▸ Covers of Layers to Ground… offers them at any time. The import report is kept with the map and File ▸ Import Report… shows it again. Custom biomes come in as biomes of the map, exported by their ids, and any biome of the map that is not the game's can be renamed and recoloured (map, grass, leaves) with a right-click in the Biomes panel. WorldPainter objects of its own kind and custom annotation layers, which were dropped, come in too. A map of many imported objects no longer spends several milliseconds every frame checking whether its layers changed. Every custom layer keeps the colour WorldPainter shows it in, and a ground cover its opacity, rather than Massif's greens.
